# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for the Node.js shopping application.

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | High-level application architecture and internal component relationship diagrams. |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category, including version and compatibility observations. |
| [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Express route inventory, contract model summary, service communication patterns, and checkout sequence. |
| [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](data-architecture.md) | MongoDB and Mongoose persistence documentation, entity model, repository method usage, and data sensitivity classification. |
| [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Configuration sources, profiles, properties, startup dependencies, secrets handling, and runtime versions. |
| [Core Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Domain entities, workflow descriptions, cross-service data flow observations, and business rules. |
